editorial:
Ever feel like you just want to run away from everything and have a wild adventure with your best friends? That is exactly what happens here. You follow six high schoolers who sneak off to an old, abandoned mine just to hang out and be free for a week. At first, it feels like a fun summer vacation, but things quickly turn into a fight for survival. You get to see how these teens deal with stress and fear when their little hideout becomes a battleground. The vibe starts off light and breezy but slowly gets more intense as the days go by.

What really works is how the movie shows the friendship and tension between the group. The animation is clean, and the action scenes keep you on your toes. Some parts of the story move a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love coming-of-age stories with a twist, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp visuals, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with your buddies.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the students finally breaking free from the conflict and returning to their normal lives. After spending seven days fighting and surviving in the mine, they realize how much they have grown. The twist is that the war was mostly a result of their own misunderstandings and ego. They leave the mine not as kids playing a game, but as adults who understand the real cost of fighting and the value of peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen dramas and survival stories.
